subject: SIG request — development change-exception ledger & CI gate narrative for Aurora Financial
messages:
From: Claire Mercer <claire.mercer@aurorafin.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: audit-team@aurorafin.com
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake — SDLC artifacts we need for our assessment

Hi Logan,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of Aurora Financial's SIG assessment we need a short packet describing how Redwood manages developer changes and CI/CD gating. At minimum we'd like:

- A change-exception ledger (all exceptions to approved change windows) for the last 12 months
- A narrative describing CI gating and automated/automated-blocking checks (including PR checks, policy enforcement, and rollback triggers)
- Code review policy + sampling evidence for mainline merges
- High-level secrets handling summary (ephemeral credentials, KMS integration, and rotation frequency)

Can you confirm whether you can provide these artifacts and an estimated date/time when you can deliver? If there are any items that need redaction, call that out. We can accept a shared Drive folder or a zipped packet.

Claire Mercer
Sr. Information Risk Manager | Aurora Financial
claire.mercer@aurorafin.com

P.S. If it helps, our assessor (Secura) is copied on this thread for any technical clarifications.
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Mercer <claire.mercer@aurorafin.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake — SDLC artifacts we need for our assessment

Claire — thanks for the clear list. We can put together a curated packet. High-level timeline:

- Preliminary packet (redacted) and narrative: by Mon 2027-09-06 EOD PT
- Full ledger export and sample pipeline logs: by Thu 2027-09-09 (if needed)

Irene will own the change-exception ledger export; Jordan will provide the CI gating narrative and representative pipeline run logs; Kimberly will prepare the secrets stewardship summary and note any redactions.

I will assemble everything into a single Drive folder and share a download link. If Aurora prefers a signed delivery (DocuSign or similar) let me know and I will add that to the package.

Quick confirmations: is CSV acceptable for change logs? Do you need PR-level diffs for specific merges or just PR metadata and approval stamps?

Thanks,

– Logan Wright
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Claire Mercer <claire.mercer@aurorafin.com>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake — SDLC artifacts we need for our assessment

Hi Claire / Logan,

Attached is the change-exception ledger (stubbed filename below). Notes on content and provenance:

- change-exception-ledger-2027Q3.csv (attachment) — export from our change-management database including: exception_id, requestor, scope, change_window_requested, approved_by, approval_timestamp, mitigation_notes, status, rollback_plan_reference. We redact internal IP addresses and specific customer identifiers.
- Exceptions are raised via our approved change workflow. Urgent/critical exceptions are flagged and require two approvers: Change Manager + Engineering Lead.
- Every exception links to a ticket in our tracking system (we will include a sanitized ticket list).

A couple of clarifications for Aurora:
- CSV format is fine, and we will include a short mapping document.
- For PR-level artifacts: we can provide PR metadata and approval stamps (reviewers, timestamps, merge commit hash). We do not provide full diffs in the packet unless explicitly requested and with an NDA addendum.

I am attaching: ci-gating-narrative-v1.pdf (draft) and code-review-policy-summary-2027.md (summary). Jordan will send pipeline logs referenced in the narrative. Kimberly will add the secrets stewardship doc.

On Fri, Sep 3, 2027 at 09:05 AM Claire Mercer <claire.mercer@aurorafin.com> wrote:
> Thanks — that format works for us.
>
> Claire

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Release Engineering | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
From: Claire Mercer <claire.mercer@aurorafin.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: assessor@secura.io
Date: Sat, 04 Sep 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake — SDLC artifacts we need for our assessment

Logan / Irene,

This is helpful — thanks. A few follow-ups from Secura that will help close the scope:

1) For the CI gating narrative: can you provide a sample pipeline run log (sanitized) showing the gating checks and the step where a failing gating policy caused a block or a manual override? We only need 2 representative runs.

2) Secrets: confirm that ephemeral tokens are used for build agents and that AWS KMS is used for at-rest key encryption. Please include rotation frequency and the process owners.

3) Change exceptions: for any exception flagged as "emergency" in the ledger, can you also include the ticket reference and the authorizing approver's role (e.g., "Security Lead")? No private text bodies are required.

If possible, please put the artifacts in a Drive folder and share a link with the assessor. If anything needs a separate NDA or additional redaction, flag it.

Claire Mercer
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Mercer <claire.mercer@aurorafin.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake — SDLC artifacts we need for our assessment

Claire — thanks for the follow-ups. Final consolidated answers and delivery details below. We put everything into a shared Drive folder and attached a zipped packet for convenience.

What we delivered (Drive folder + attachments):
- sdlc-artifact-bundle-AF-0342.zip (contains redacted ledger export and narrative PDFs)
- change-exception-ledger-2027Q3.csv (CSV: exception_id, requestor_email(redacted), scope, change_window, approver_role, approval_timestamp, status, rollback_plan_ref)
- ci-gating-narrative-v1.pdf (detailed narrative + sequence diagrams showing gating decisions)
- sample-pipeline-run-logs/ (2 sanitized runs) — pipeline-run-20270812-1234.log, pipeline-run-20270721-0810.log
- code-review-policy-summary-2027.md (policy + sample approval stamps)
- secrets-stewardship-overview.pdf (ephemeral agent token flow, KMS usage, rotation cadence)

Direct clarifications:
- CI gating: the sample logs show an instance where a failing static-scan check blocked a merge and the remediation flow that followed. We include timestamps and job IDs but have redacted any customer-specific filenames.
- Secrets: build agents use ephemeral tokens provisioned by our workload identity broker (rotated per pipeline run). We use customer-managed keys via AWS KMS for encrypted at-rest secrets. Rotation: KMS CMKs are rotated annually; short-lived signing/agent tokens rotate per pipeline invocation. Process owners: Security Engineering + Platform (names omitted here; full roles included in the packet).
- Emergency exceptions: ledger rows flagged as "emergency" include ticket reference and approver_role column (e.g., Security Lead, Engineering VP). We have redacted the private narrative fields but preserved ticket IDs and approver roles as requested.

Delivery links and references:
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-examples-AF-0342
- HubSpot record: HS-51724 (SIG intake ticket)
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/signon?f=AF-0342-signature (if Aurora requires signed receipt)

If Secura needs additional artifact formats (e.g., full PR diffs for 2 sample merges) please let us know and we will follow the NDA path to share. Otherwise we believe the packet meets SIG expectations for SDLC evidence on change management, CI gating, code review, and secrets handling.

Thanks,

Logan Wright
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198
